scripts.site: go run github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ@v0.3.1070 generate -path site && tailwindcss -i site/app.css -o site/dist/assets/app.css --minify && go run ./site
scripts.site:serve: bun run site && python3 -m http.server 4100 -d site/dist
scripts.console: go run github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ@v0.3.1070 generate -path apps/console && tailwindcss -i apps/console/app.css -o apps/console/assets/app.css --minify && go run ./apps/console
